from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from datetime import datetime

router = APIRouter(prefix="/telehealth/appointments")

class AppointmentSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    appointment_id: str
    scheduled_start: datetime
    clinician_name: str

@router.get("/{appointment_id}/summary", response_model=AppointmentSummaryResponse)
async def get_appointment_summary(
    appointment_id: str,
    clinic_svc: ClinicService = Depends(get_clinic_service),
    staff: ClinicStaffUser = Depends(get_clinic_staff_user)
):
    apt = await clinic_svc.get_appointment(appointment_id)
    if not apt:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Appointment not found")
    if apt.clinic_id != staff.assigned_clinic_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: staff member not assigned to this clinic branch")

    return AppointmentSummaryResponse(
        appointment_id=apt.id,
        scheduled_start=apt.start_time,
        clinician_name=apt.doctor_name
    )
